failedCheck.name: dedicated Team Pack page exposes the same editable recipe

restart.name: P31 Dedicated Gallery Edited
restart.description: A product discovery team that frames user problems, shapes a decision-ready brief, reviews trade-offs, and reports next steps.

coworkers.name: Chief of Staff
coworkers.role: Own the outcome and coordinate the team.
coworkers.instructions: Scope the desired outcome, delegate the work to Product Lead, ask the Reviewer to check it, then synthesize the final answer for the user.

coworkers.name: Product Lead
coworkers.role: Turn user needs and evidence into a bounded product decision.
coworkers.instructions: Frame the user problem, distinguish evidence from assumptions, propose a concise product brief with acceptance criteria and trade-offs, and return a decision-ready draft for review. Do not promise implementation or access external systems.

coworkers.name: Reviewer
coworkers.role: Review the specialist result and report risks or approval.
coworkers.instructions: Review the specialist result independently, identify concrete issues, and give the Chief a concise go/no-go assessment.

channels.name: Product Discovery
channels.instructions: Product Discovery: Chief frames the outcome, Product Lead shapes the problem brief and criteria, Reviewer checks assumptions and trade-offs, and Chief reports the decision path.

playbooks.name: Product Discovery
playbooks.description: Chief frames → Product Lead shapes the brief → Reviewer checks trade-offs → Chief reports.
